replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
The only thing I worry about; Will the map be too big? Avicus is not a large server, it doesn't have a ridiculous amount of players. The size of the map could potentially be an issue. 

Aesthetically, it looks beautiful. I'm genuinely impressed x3 But in terms of lag, how will players with subpar computers play? Will they get a ridiculous amount of lag? This can drive players to not play your map, leading to small games, referring to my first point.

Aka, people are mainly looking at aesthetics. Keep gameplay in mind too pls.

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
the size of the build shouldn't matter too much, you should still be getting about the same fps. maybe a bit of a dip here and there. a huuuuge build would have an affect on it, but this isn't as big as some builds i've been around, and those haven't effected my fps at all.

also, the gameplay will be great. the amount of players will be fine; personally, i enjoy playing on huge maps with smaller amounts of players more. it allows for easier access to the other side, and then you start pvping. you don't get as stuck on your own side or the middle and it's just generally more fun.

aesthetics are amazing ofc.
